titulo: Can I get the recipe, five words
caption:
Can I get the recipe, five words

"Can I get the recipe?" It is the nicest thing you can say about a dish, and it takes five words.

Asking for the recipe tells the cook the food worked, and it is easier to say than a speech.

For whoever asks for the recipe.

Choose friction.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A kitchen with a plate holding a bite of food in the middle. A ink-black block figure with white eyes walks to the plate, the food disappears, its eyes go wide and a bubble says can I get the recipe? A royal blue block figure on the right opens its eyes wide and then happy ones and a bubble says I'll show you. Both end with happy eyes. The text stays: me asking for the recipe.
